A sociolinguistic study of bagheli speakers in madhya pradesh\.
Technical Report 2022\-015, SIL International, 2022\.
The report was created in 2004 and published in 2022\. All eighteen target lects attach to canonical Bagheli\. Similarity\-group numbers remain source notes and are not treated as historical cognacy\. Two readable forms lacking any printed site code remain excluded, one source\-questioned form is installed without punctuation but explicitly annotated, and one uppercase site code is interpreted conservatively at medium confidence\. The report names localities but supplies no defensible historical collection coordinates\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/94596](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/94596)\.
references.progress: Appendix B.4, printed pages 50--72: 5,828 manually transcribed Bagheli source-local occurrence rows from eighteen locality lists, yielding 5,829 compiled lexical variants after the source's comma-separated alternatives at item 173 site m are expanded. Two hundred eighty-three Standard Hindi occurrences, twenty-four non-lexical by-name occurrences, forty-seven blank conceptual cells, and two legible but site-unassigned response lines are audit-only
references.provenance: Official SIL publisher PDF downloaded 2026-08-28, SHA-256 d1424f317dc12fe01d99d33abd917201575487f4de44529678ecce1c282a4627; the PDF is not redistributed. Reproducible embedded-image extraction, 92-column OCR comparison scaffold, frozen manual transcription, source-local importer, complete 6,184-record audit and manifest are in data/other/forms/raw_data/sil_bagheli_2022; installed rows are data/other/forms/20260828-sil-bagheli.csv

A sociolinguistic study of bagheli speakers in madhya pradesh\.
Technical Report 2022\-015, SIL International, 2022\.
The report was created in 2004 and published in 2022\. All eighteen target lects attach to canonical Bagheli\. Similarity\-group numbers remain source notes and are not treated as historical cognacy\. Two readable forms lacking any printed site code remain excluded, one source\-questioned form is installed without punctuation but explicitly annotated, and one uppercase site code is interpreted conservatively at medium confidence\. The report names localities but supplies no defensible historical collection coordinates\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/94596](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/94596)\.
references.progress: Appendix B.4, printed pages 50--72: 5,828 manually transcribed Bagheli source-local occurrence rows from eighteen locality lists, yielding 5,829 compiled lexical variants after the source's comma-separated alternatives at item 173 site m are expanded. Two hundred eighty-three Standard Hindi occurrences, twenty-four non-lexical by-name occurrences, forty-seven blank conceptual cells, and two legible but site-unassigned response lines are audit-only
references.provenance: Official SIL publisher PDF downloaded 2026-08-28, SHA-256 d1424f317dc12fe01d99d33abd917201575487f4de44529678ecce1c282a4627; the PDF is not redistributed. references.source:
Binoy Koshy\.
A sociolinguistic study of bagheli speakers in madhya pradesh\.
Technical Report 2022\-015, SIL International, 2022\.
The report was created in 2004 and published in 2022\. All eighteen target lects attach to canonical Bagheli\. Similarity\-group numbers remain source notes and are not treated as historical cognacy\. Two readable forms lacking any printed site code remain excluded, one source\-questioned form is installed without punctuation but explicitly annotated, and one uppercase site code is interpreted conservatively at medium confidence\. The report names localities but supplies no defensible historical collection coordinates\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/94596](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/94596)\.
references.progress: Appendix B.4, printed pages 50--72: 5,828 manually transcribed Bagheli source-local occurrence rows from eighteen locality lists, yielding 5,829 compiled lexical variants after the source's comma-separated alternatives at item 173 site m are expanded. Two hundred eighty-three Standard Hindi occurrences, twenty-four non-lexical by-name occurrences, forty-seven blank conceptual cells, and two legible but site-unassigned response lines are audit-only

A sociolinguistic study of bagheli speakers in madhya pradesh\.
Technical Report 2022\-015, SIL International, 2022\.
The report was created in 2004 and published in 2022\. All eighteen target lects attach to canonical Bagheli\. Similarity\-group numbers remain source notes and are not treated as historical cognacy\. Two readable forms lacking any printed site code remain excluded, one source\-questioned form is installed without punctuation but explicitly annotated, and one uppercase site code is interpreted conservatively at medium confidence\. The report names localities but supplies no defensible historical collection coordinates\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/94596](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/94596)\.
references.progress: Appendix B.4, printed pages 50--72: 5,828 manually transcribed Bagheli source-local occurrence rows from eighteen locality lists, yielding 5,829 compiled lexical variants after the source's comma-separated alternatives at item 173 site m are expanded. Two hundred eighty-three Standard Hindi occurrences, twenty-four non-lexical by-name occurrences, forty-seven blank conceptual cells, and two legible but site-unassigned response lines are audit-only

references.source:
Binoy Koshy\.
A sociolinguistic study of bagheli speakers in madhya pradesh\.
Technical Report 2022\-015, SIL International, 2022\.
The report was created in 2004 and published in 2022\. All eighteen target lects attach to canonical Bagheli\. Similarity\-group numbers remain source notes and are not treated as historical cognacy\. Two readable forms lacking any printed site code remain excluded, one source\-questioned form is installed without punctuation but explicitly annotated, and one uppercase site code is interpreted conservatively at medium confidence\. The report names localities but supplies no defensible historical collection coordinates\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/94596](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/94596)\.
references.progress: Appendix B.4, printed pages 50--72: 5,828 manually transcribed Bagheli source-local occurrence rows from eighteen locality lists, yielding 5,829 compiled lexical variants after the source's comma-separated alternatives at item 173 site m are expanded. Two hundred eighty-three Standard Hindi occurrences, twenty-four non-lexical by-name occurrences, forty-seven blank conceptual cells, and two legible but site-unassigned response lines are audit-only
references.provenance: Official SIL publisher PDF downloaded 2026-08-28, SHA-256 d1424f317dc12fe01d99d33abd917201575487f4de44529678ecce1c282a4627; the PDF is not redistributed. Reproducible embedded-image extraction, 92-column OCR comparison scaffold, frozen manual transcription, source-local importer, complete 6,184-record audit and manifest are in data/other/forms/raw_data/sil_bagheli_2022; installed rows are data/other/forms/20260828-sil-bagheli.csv
references.locator: Appendix B.4, printed p. 69, item 188, site D

references.source:
Binoy Koshy\.
A sociolinguistic study of bagheli speakers in madhya pradesh\.
Technical Report 2022\-015, SIL International, 2022\.
The report was created in 2004 and published in 2022\. All eighteen target lects attach to canonical Bagheli\. Similarity\-group numbers remain source notes and are not treated as historical cognacy\. Two readable forms lacking any printed site code remain excluded, one source\-questioned form is installed without punctuation but explicitly annotated, and one uppercase site code is interpreted conservatively at medium confidence\. The report names localities but supplies no defensible historical collection coordinates\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/94596](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/94596)\.
references.progress: Appendix B.4, printed pages 50--72: 5,828 manually transcribed Bagheli source-local occurrence rows from eighteen locality lists, yielding 5,829 compiled lexical variants after the source's comma-separated alternatives at item 173 site m are expanded. Two hundred eighty-three Standard Hindi occurrences, twenty-four non-lexical by-name occurrences, forty-seven blank conceptual cells, and two legible but site-unassigned response lines are audit-only
references.provenance: Official SIL publisher PDF downloaded 2026-08-28, SHA-256 d1424f317dc12fe01d99d33abd917201575487f4de44529678ecce1c282a4627; the PDF is not redistributed. Reproducible embedded-image extraction, 92-column OCR comparison scaffold, frozen manual transcription, source-local importer, complete 6,184-record audit and manifest are in data/other/forms/raw_data/sil_bagheli_2022; installed rows are data/other/forms/20260828-sil-bagheli.csv

A sociolinguistic study of bagheli speakers in madhya pradesh\.
Technical Report 2022\-015, SIL International, 2022\.
The report was created in 2004 and published in 2022\. All eighteen target lects attach to canonical Bagheli\. Similarity\-group numbers remain source notes and are not treated as historical cognacy\. Two readable forms lacking any printed site code remain excluded, one source\-questioned form is installed without punctuation but explicitly annotated, and one uppercase site code is interpreted conservatively at medium confidence\. The report names localities but supplies no defensible historical collection coordinates\.
URL: [https://www\.sil\.org/resources/archives/94596](https://www.sil.org/resources/archives/94596)\.
references.progress: Appendix B.4, printed pages 50--72: 5,828 manually transcribed Bagheli source-local occurrence rows from eighteen locality lists, yielding 5,829 compiled lexical variants after the source's comma-separated alternatives at item 173 site m are expanded. Two hundred eighty-three Standard Hindi occurrences, twenty-four non-lexical by-name occurrences, forty-seven blank conceptual cells, and two legible but site-unassigned response lines are audit-only
references.provenance: Official SIL publisher PDF downloaded 2026-08-28, SHA-256 d1424f317dc12fe01d99d33abd917201575487f4de44529678ecce1c282a4627; the PDF is not redistributed. Reproducible embedded-image extraction, 92-column OCR comparison scaffold, frozen manual transcription, source-local importer, complete 6,184-record audit and manifest are in data/other/forms/raw_data/sil_bagheli_2022; installed rows are data/other/forms/20260828-sil-bagheli.csv
references.locator: Appendix B.4, printed p. 72, item 209, site D
